scope: Native PlayerBase command eligibility, execution dispatch, direct server fallback and typed Lua argument serialization. Conditional on the selected descriptor and fallback executing. Named incoming definitions are recorded separately; no captured Bazaar request or server behavior is established.
method: Retained Ghidra instruction listings were compared byte-for-byte with the identified PE using its section table. RTTI, vtable entries, literals and initial data were read from that PE. Addresses below are virtual addresses; subtract imageBase for RVAs.

facts: Tests player control +0x5c, extracts argument 0 name with 0x0071CE70 and looks up the descriptor in player +0xfc with 0x0071CA50.

If descriptor virtual +0x1c is true, reads priority through virtual +0x20 and calls 0x00893320; otherwise returns true. No comparison with Bazaar IDs or interpretation of Bazaar tail operands occurs here.
Lua PlayerBaseClass.canCommand skips this native call when the selected command name is commandRequest. Thus the three Bazaar IDs do not execute this native eligibility function on that Lua route.

anchors.fact: Copies argument list from index 1 through 0x00753B90; also checks object references.
Dispatches through 0x00898480 after active-binding and self-state gates.

execution.eventType: Both descriptor vtables have slot 5 = 0x00899120, returning reference 0x0134C3FF. It lies in PE virtual zero-fill, initially zero on loading; no live value is established. See command_descriptor_registration.json#globals.
execution.registration: manifests/command_descriptor_registration.json: retained s2c 0x0132 definitions establish name/priority/selector inputs and conditional constructors. Runtime first-match descriptor selection remains unobserved.

anchors.fact: Constructs writer 0x0078F790 over a zeroed 128-byte buffer.
Supplies argument start index 2: name and command object are envelope inputs.

directFallback.routeBoundary: 0x0075E230 and 0x0075E3A0 are separate event-wrapper routes. Their Event::Base +0x08 mapping must not be substituted for the direct fallback fields below.

wire.offsetBasis: application payload after the 16-byte game-message prefix

fields.source: command control binding reference resolved by 0x00CC73B0; copied into local event record +0 by 0x0089EC30
self actor object +0x14, copied to protocol-context +8 by 0x0075D460
CRC32 over exact 128-byte typed tail, through 0x00D3AB60 and 0x00D3AAE0
descriptor slot 5 type reference; PE virtual zero-fill initially supplies 0 for both families, without an observed runtime value
remaining argument list in original order
No write or semantic meaning established by this builder.

wire.commandIdentity: No separate scalar command-sheet ID is inserted. Command object binding reference supplies an envelope identity. Sheet ID, binding reference and self actor fields are distinct domains.

luaBridge.signature: 0x0073D1E0 loads registry element 9 for argument index 2 at 0x0073D2DF; 0x00CC9D60 installs inner vtable 0x0110E0A0 at 0x00CCA090, whose +4 entry is 0x00CF8980.
luaBridge.varargs: 0x00CF8980 loops through the actual Lua stack arguments, preserving explicit trailing nil positions. It does not supply missing arguments.
luaBridge.numbers: Numeric TValue tag 3 is tested by 0x00CF3840 at 0x00CF89A9. Predicate 0x00CF3670 at 0x00CF89B5 compares the original Lua double with a signed64 truncation round trip (0x00CF369A, 0x00CF36A4, 0x00CF36B1, 0x00CF36B5). Ordered equality selects element 0 / 0x00CFAC40, producing internal tag 0 through 0x00583D90. Otherwise element 1 / 0x00CFADF0 produces float32 tag 1 through 0x0073E010. No separate signed32 range check is established. Ordinary signed32 integral operands use tag 0.
luaBridge.nil: Element 6 selected at 0x00CF8AB5 uses inner vtable 0x0110E028 +4 = 0x00CFB9C0; holder 0x00583F70 writes internal tag 6 at 0x00583FD9.

serializer.walker: 0x00790ED0 iterates ordered 16-byte entries from supplied index 2 to end and calls 0x007933A0 at 0x00790F3C. Entry data pointer is +8 and signed internal tag +0x0c. No command-dependent trimming, padding or length prefix.
serializer.endian: Native envelope scalar fields are little-endian. Typed numeric/reference values take the big-endian branch when 0x0134B368 <= 0. The PE initial value is zero; a targeted scan of its original .text references found 37 reads and 37 writes, all writes setting -1. No live mutation was tested.
serializer.control: 0x0075AFA0 resolves a control reference with 0x00CC73B0 and tests registry classification with 0x00CC70B0. Non-item branch emits 06 + binding-reference u32be via 0x007901F0 -> 0x00791800.

item.classification: Registry branch casts LuaControl (RTTI 0x01270B4C) to ItemBase (0x012C0864) at 0x0075AFFE, then calls 0x006F5260 at 0x0075B00E.
item.tuple: 0x006F5260 resolves ItemBase +0x64 through 0x00CC73B0 at 0x006F52BE, reading binding entry +0x70. It copies package from item +0x68, slot from +0x6c, and metadata from resolved item record +0x10/+0x14.
item.notation: R = resolved binding-reference dword, S = slot low word, P = package low byte; raw actor-ID equivalence is not established.
item.counted: 08 R:u32be S1:u16be P1:u8 N:u8 (S2:u16be P2:u8 ... SN:u16be PN:u8) L:u8; L = 3*N+7
item.coalescing: 0x00790BA0 examines the last encoded value via 0x007906C0. It extends only a preceding 07/08 with equal R (0x00790C45..0x00790C6D). Emitted scalar, nil or different reference prevents grouping; omitted entries do not. Order is preserved without sorting, deduplication or quantity aggregation.

finalizer.metadata: 0x00790BA0 sets writer +0x20 and collects metadata into two u64 slots using zero as an empty sentinel; if both slots are already nonzero it clears the flag. This is not a strict item count.
finalizer.emission: If writer +0x22 is zero and +0x20 nonzero (0x00790406..0x00790410), 0x00791910 emits 09 M1:u64be M2:u64be, followed by 0F. Semantic identities of the two metadata values remain unresolved.
finalizer.distinction: 09 is serializer-generated metadata, not a ninth Lua argument or a quantity.

serializer.terminator: 0x0078F790 zero-fills the buffer at 0x0078F7C8 and writes initial 0F at 0x0078F7D2. Each encoded value replaces the previous terminator and appends a new 0F. Untouched zero padding is not nil.
serializer.currency: There is no currency-specific serializer branch: integral currency catalog IDs and amounts use the ordinary numeric encoding when supplied as Lua numbers.

boundary.queue: 0x004D6D30 requires this+0x174ec; 0x004E0240 requires this+0x234 and nested +0x70. 0x00DAE010 requires state +0x8c == 3 for opcode 0x012d at 0x00DAE04F/52; states 1/2 admit only opcode 2. State 3 allocates through 0x00DAF850 at 0x00DAE091 and queues through 0x00DB06A0 at 0x00DAE0C9.
boundary.firstUnresolvedNativeInput: The selected runtime descriptor returned by 0x0071CA50 from the later player+0xfc vector: actual receiving implementation and handoff identity, runtime selector/default bytes, completed initialization, insertion order, lifetime and installed vtable are not observed.
boundary.firstUnresolvedServerBoundary: Server consumption of the opcode 0x012d record queued through 0x00DB06A0: no server decoder, admission, mutation, settlement, cancellation, timing or response contract is established.
boundary.observation: This is a conditional native construction contract. It does not establish that a particular request passed the gates, reached a socket, or was accepted.
